# ubuntu_kubeadm_control_plane Resource

Bootstraps a single kubeadm control-plane node on an already-prepared Linux host.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "ubuntu_kubeadm_control_plane" "example" {
  target = var.host
  config_yaml = "example"
  name = "example"
}
```
## Argument Reference

The resource supports the following arguments:

- `allow_destructive_destroy` (Optional, Computed, bool) - Explicitly allow destroy to run kubeadm reset -f on the node.
- `config_yaml` (Required, string) - Opaque kubeadm InitConfiguration/ClusterConfiguration YAML.
- `name` (Required, string) - Logical name for this kubeadm control-plane node resource.
- `port` (Optional, int64) - Target port for this resource. Overrides provider default_target.port.
- `target` (Optional, string) - Target host or address for this resource. Overrides provider default_target.target.
- `transport` (Optional, string) - Transport for this resource. The current provider surface supports ssh.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes:

- `admin_kubeconfig_path` (string) - Path to the admin kubeconfig created by kubeadm init.
- `api_server_endpoint` (string) - API server endpoint extracted from the admin kubeconfig.
- `client_certificate_pem` (string) - PEM-encoded admin client certificate from the admin kubeconfig.
- `client_key_pem` (string) - PEM-encoded admin client key from the admin kubeconfig.
- `cluster_ca_certificate_pem` (string) - PEM-encoded cluster CA certificate from the admin kubeconfig.
- `id` (string) - Stable kubeadm control-plane resource identifier.
- `initialized` (bool) - Whether the host appears initialized as a kubeadm control plane.
- `kubelet_config_path` (string) - Path to the kubelet kubeconfig on the node.
- `node_name` (string) - Detected Kubernetes node name on the host.
- `worker_ca_cert_hash` (string) - Discovery token CA cert hash for joining workers.
- `worker_join_token` (string) - Long-lived kubeadm bootstrap token for joining workers.
